passage: Early critics dismissed the photographer's images of ordinary kitchens and laundromats as trivial. Yet the pictures have proved remarkably ______: decades later, historians of everyday life use them as a primary source on how people cooked, cleaned, and spent their time.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
steps: Decades later they are still used, so they are enduring.
“Ornamental” means decorative; nothing suggests controversy; “provisional” means temporary, the opposite.
